scope: Xninetzy MCP source repo + /apps/docs source + runtime registry

findings.title: Tool count drift across every doc page
findings.root_cause: Tool count grows with every commit; docs are not regenerated. Prior audit (2026-09-20) flagged this; not yet fixed.
findings.impact: Operators reading docs make decisions on wrong numbers.
findings.fix: Either (a) derive every doc number from scripts/mcp_audit.py at build time, or (b) emit a CI drift test that fails when docs disagree with runtime.
findings.validation: Add tests/governance/test_doc_tool_count_drift.py — load every docs page, parse any `\b\d{3,}\b` next to 'tools', assert equals runtime total.

findings.title: Tableau not in v2.2.0 shipped-domains table
findings.evidence: apps/docs/src/pages/docs/introduction.md 'Domains shipped in v2.2.0' table lists 10 domains (Research, Career, Knowledge, Learning, OS kernel, Lightning, Security, External MCP gateway, Tasks extension, Self-improvement). Tableau domain is missing despite 15 tableau_* tools and a complete integration.
findings.impact: External readers will conclude Tableau is not yet shipped.
findings.fix: Add Tableau row to the table with: 15 tools, parser/IR/compiler/validator/TWBX packager, Progres1ya.twb template.

findings.title: mcp-system.md claims 4 tasks_* tools; registry has 0
findings.evidence: docs/mcp-system.md 'Tasks extension (SEP-2663, 4 tools)'. grep of registry: no tool with prefix `tasks_`. Workflow tools exist (`workflow_status` etc.) but they are not the MCP Tasks extension.
findings.impact: Operators expect durable async handle APIs that don't exist.
findings.fix: Either implement tasks_* tools (recommended) or correct the doc. Workflow tools ≠ Tasks extension.

findings.title: Lineage module never wired to artifact pipeline
findings.evidence: xninetzy/context/data_analysis/lineage.py defines `LineageEdge`, `LineageRecord` with `add()` method. Neither `generate_xlsx_artifact` nor `profile_dataset` nor any tool calls these classes.
findings.impact: Lineage contract promised by docs/runbooks/data-lineage.md (if exists) is unfulfilled. Cross-integration workflows (Kaggle→Tableau) cannot record provenance.
findings.fix: Wire `LineageRecord` into `generate_xlsx_artifact` and `TableArtifact.to_dict()`; expose `lineage_record(parent_id, child_id, operation)` tool.

findings.title: Tool annotations computed but never pushed to MCP wire
findings.evidence: xninetzy/tools/tool_meta.py::meta_for computes MCP annotations (readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint/openWorldHint). xninetzy/interfaces/mcp_tool_adapter.py::expose_xninetzy_tools calls `server.add_tool(callable, name=name, description=description)` — no annotations kwarg.
findings.impact: MCP clients see no annotations; cannot programmatically distinguish read vs write tools. Reduces client-side safety.
findings.fix: Add `annotations=meta_for(tool.name)['annotations']` to the `add_tool` call in expose_xninetzy_tools.

findings.title: Tool input schemas not validated against JSON Schema 2020-12
findings.evidence: FastMCP uses pydantic models under the hood. No CI check verifies all schemas are JSON Schema 2020-12 compatible.
findings.impact: Incompatible schema fields (e.g. tuple vs array, int > 2^53) can fail silently in some MCP clients.
findings.fix: Add tests/governance/test_mcp_schema_compliance.py that dumps each tool schema via `mcp._tool_manager.list_tools()` and round-trips through jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.

findings.title: Skill count claim '78 skill directories' but filesystem has 83
findings.evidence: apps/docs/src/pages/docs/skills.md: '78 skill directories (116 SKILL.md files including nested)'. `find .agents/skills -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | wc -l` returns 83. `find .agents/skills -name SKILL.md | wc -l` returns 122.
findings.impact: Skill catalog pages undercount.
findings.fix: Either count at build time or update doc with current numbers (83 dirs / 122 SKILL.md).

findings.title: Two audit reports competing (2026-09-20 + this one)
findings.evidence: apps/docs/src/pages/docs/audit-report-2026-09-20.md exists with 4 P0 wrong-numbers findings. As of 2026-09-22 the same drift still exists; this audit re-asserts it.
findings.impact: Operators may treat the older report as authoritative.
findings.fix: Either (a) retire the older report and link to /audit/ in repo, or (b) replace with a single always-current report built from scripts/mcp_audit.py at release time.

findings.title: Cross-integration Kaggle→Colab→Tableau chain unsupported
findings.evidence: Kaggle tools return local file paths (KAGGLE_WORKSPACE_DIR). Tableau tools accept local CSV via datasource_replace/compile_datasource_from_csv. No tool exists to (a) move Kaggle artifacts into a 'next stage' workspace, (b) record the parent→child lineage, (c) hand off the artifact ID to Tableau without re-pathing.
findings.impact: The headline 'Kaggle → Colab → Tableau' workflow is documented but cannot complete end-to-end with explicit contracts.
findings.fix: Add `artifact_pass(parent_id, target_workspace)` tool; integrate `LineageRecord` into the Kaggle download + Tableau generate path; expose `artifact_id` as first-class return value of `kaggle_dataset_download`.

findings.title: No MCP Tasks extension (SEP-2663) implementation
findings.evidence: docs/mcp-system.md promises 4 `tasks_*` tools. Registry has 0. Workflow tools exist but are not the SEP-2663 extension.
findings.impact: Long-running ops (notebook exec, dataset download, Tableau generation) block a single MCP request or run on hidden background queue without durable handle.
findings.fix: Implement tasks_get/tasks_update/tasks_cancel/tasks_list as thin wrappers over the existing `workflow_*` store with idempotent handles, or drop the doc claim.

findings.title: Self-improvement pipeline has no sandbox isolation
findings.evidence: lightning_* and improvement_* tools can `apply_proposal`. `patch_executor.py` exists (os/improvement/patch_executor.py). No tests confirm patch_executor is invoked in a sandboxed subprocess with rollback on failure.
findings.impact: Promoted patches could break production with no safe rollback path.
findings.fix: Wrap patch application in a subprocess with `--no-side-effects` smoke mode + automatic rollback on post-apply test failure.

findings.title: No OpenTelemetry exporter wired
findings.evidence: observability/trace.py has W3C traceparent parsing + ContextVar. observability/perf.py has in-process metrics. No OTLP exporter, no Prometheus pull endpoint.
findings.impact: Operators cannot observe spans across processes or aggregate metrics externally.
findings.fix: Add `xninetzy/observability/otlp.py` with an OTLP gRPC exporter; gate via env var XNINETZY_OTLP_ENDPOINT.

findings.title: No golden task suite
findings.evidence: tests/ has 215 test files but no tests/golden/ directory. `xninetzy/context/evaluation/` has 11 modules (audit_trail, benchmark, context_eval, hallucination, memory_eval, outcome, root_cause, routing_eval, scoring, security, skill, tool) — all are evaluator primitives, no scenario registry.
findings.impact: Cannot objectively measure whether a refactor improves tool selection, workflow completion, or recovery behavior.
findings.fix: Add tests/golden/ with scenario YAMLs (input, expected_tools, expected_artifacts, invariants, timeout) and a runner that drives the live MCP server through stdio.

findings.title: No documentation for capability registry
findings.evidence: No page under apps/docs/src/pages/docs/ covers the capability/tool/skill/agent/workflow registry model. The architecture.md mentions 'tool registry' but not 'capability registry'.
findings.impact: New contributors cannot discover the registry model.
findings.fix: Add apps/docs/src/pages/docs/capability-registry.md describing ToolManifest, FeaturePack, RiskClass, requires_idempotency/approval/evidence.

findings.title: No path-traversal regression test suite for Kaggle/Tableau/Obsidian
findings.evidence: tests/integrations/kaggle/test_safe_paths.py (rewritten) and tests/integrations/tableau/test_safe_paths.py exist. No tests/governance/test_path_traversal_global.py aggregating across integrations. tests/os/security/ not enumerated.
findings.impact: A future PR to one integration could reintroduce path traversal.
findings.fix: Add tests/security/test_workspace_path_safety.py that fuzz-tests safe_join across all 3 integrations.

findings.title: No failure corpus / regression-from-failure pipeline
findings.evidence: os/improvement has store + patch_executor + learning_feed. memory_failure_store exists. No `failure_to_regression_test` automation. The loop is observability → improvement_propose → improvement_approve → apply; regression tests are not auto-derived.
findings.impact: Failures stay textual in memory; same bug can re-occur.
findings.fix: When memory_failure_store fires, auto-generate a pytest case skeleton in tests/regressions/ derived from failure signature.

findings.title: docs/skills.md and docs/index.astro list overlapping skill names
findings.evidence: skills.md lists 19 career skills + a 'additional open-source skills' table. index.astro has a separate skills block. No single source of truth for the catalog.
findings.impact: Adding a new skill requires editing 2-3 places.
findings.fix: Generate both from `find .agents/skills -name SKILL.md` at docs build time.

findings.title: No native Jupyter execution adapter
findings.evidence: kaggle_notebook_run exists. There is no separate `colab_*` or `jupyter_*` tool. A Colab/Google Drive integration would require it (per prior prompt).
findings.impact: Workflow Kaggle→Colab→Tableau stops at Kaggle because Colab layer does not exist.
findings.fix: Implement 6 colab_* tools at minimum: colab_capabilities, colab_drive_search, colab_notebook_inspect, colab_runtime_specs, colab_runtime_connect, colab_notebook_execute (each gated by Google OAuth).

findings.title: Tool count of 455 risks context-window saturation
findings.evidence: 455 tool descriptions + JSON schemas exceed 100k tokens when serialised into a single MCP tools/list response. Hosts typically select from a subset.
findings.impact: Cold-start prompts balloon; selection accuracy degrades.
findings.fix: (a) Group tools by `feature_pack` in MCP resources (xninetzy://tools/catalog?pack=research), (b) add `tool_route(query, candidate_tools, top_n=10)` to pre-filter.

findings.title: No replay system for failures
findings.evidence: memory_failure_store persists failures. lightning_episode_get can replay episode. No `replay_failure(failure_id)` or deterministic reproduction harness.
findings.impact: Fixes cannot be verified against the original failing run.
findings.fix: Add `replay_failure(failure_id)` tool that re-runs the episode with same seed + mocked external services.

layers: Discovery (capability registry, tool registry, skill registry, workflow registry)
Execution (planner, task manager, workflow engine, executor, verifier, recovery)
Data (ingestion, profiling, quality, transformation, statistics, visualization)
Evaluation (golden tasks, replay, regression, fault injection, metrics)
Improvement (failure mining, root cause, proposal, sandbox, comparison, promotion)
Integrations (Kaggle, Tableau, Git, Web, DB, future Colab/Drive)
target_architecture.status: PARTIAL — current Xninetzy already covers 6/9 layers; missing: durable task handles, statistical analysis layer, replay system, sandboxed self-improvement.

implementation_plan: P0: Fix doc tool-count drift via CI test (F-001)
P0: Wire MCP annotations to wire (F-005)
P1: Wire lineage into artifact pipeline (F-004, F-009)
P1: Implement SEP-2663 Tasks extension OR correct doc (F-010)
P1: Add path-traversal global regression suite (F-015)
P2: Add golden task suite in tests/golden/
P2: Generate skill catalog at docs build time (F-017)

final_questions.q1_what_xninetzy_is_today: A 455-tool MCP server (FastMCP stdio|streamable-http, loopback) over 12+ domains: research, career, knowledge, learning, OS kernel, lightning, security, improvement, memory, evaluation, data intelligence, kaggle, tableau, process engineering, Obsidian. Local-first, single-owner, owner-injected via mcp_principal().
final_questions.q2_what_website_claims: Cannot verify (cache miss). Source /apps/docs claims 406 tools but runtime has 455.
final_questions.q3_where_differ: Tool counts (343→406→455 drift), skill counts (68→78→83), tasks_* tools claimed but not present, Tableau not in shipped-domains table.
final_questions.q4_production_ready: Tools: data analysis (profiling/quality), Kaggle (20), Tableau (15), Obsidian (~35), HEBAT (15), Lightning (19), Improvement (7), Memory (13), Evaluation (18), Learning (25).
final_questions.q5_partial: Cross-integration artifact handoff, lineage, statistical analysis, durable async tasks.
final_questions.q7_biggest_mcp_gap: Annotations not pushed to wire (F-005); no OTLP exporter (F-012).
final_questions.q8_biggest_tool_gap: No statistical analysis tools (mean/median/correlation) despite Part XIV prompt requirement.
final_questions.q9_biggest_skill_gap: No Colab/Drive skills despite previous prompt.
final_questions.q10_biggest_agent_gap: Xninetzy intentionally has no agent layer; agents live in host (OpenCode/Claude Code).
final_questions.q11_biggest_workflow_gap: No SEP-2663 durable tasks (F-010); workflow is inline (per executor.py docstring).
final_questions.q12_biggest_data_gap: Statistical analysis layer missing (correlation, regression, time series).
final_questions.q15_biggest_recovery_gap: S6 harness has harness_recover + recovery_choose, but no automatic rollback-on-regression.
final_questions.q16_biggest_security_gap: Path-traversal coverage is per-integration (Kaggle/Tableau), not global (F-015).
final_questions.q20_merge: Tool count source: scripts/mcp_audit.py → docs build.
final_questions.q21_shared_primitive: Capability registry (manifest.py pattern) → expand to skill/workflow/agent.
final_questions.q22_integration_specific: Kaggle provider abstraction (already there); Tableau workspace layout (specific).
final_questions.q24_under_engineered: Statistical analysis, durable async tasks, lineage.
final_questions.q28_minimum_target_arch: Add lineage wiring + tasks_* extension + stat tools + OTLP. 4 small additions.
final_questions.q29_next_phase: Fix F-001 (CI doc drift test) + F-005 (push annotations) + F-004 (wire lineage).
final_questions.q30_unknowns: Deployed website content (cannot fetch); real Tableau Desktop validation (no Desktop install); live Colab API allowlist status (not tested).
